name: RewardPrediction
description: RewardPrediction is a benchmark dataset spanning five diverse domains with 2,454 unique action-observation trajectories and step-wise ground-truth rewards. It evaluates reward prediction models' ability to generalize across domains using factorized world state representations.
reputation: A niche but recognized benchmark in reward modeling and generalization research, mainly used in academic work rather than broad community leaderboards.
notes: Includes hierarchical object-attribute state representations and evaluates zero-shot reward prediction generalization.
